title: Putin wants to draft 300,000 new troops for war, Ukraine’s Zelensky says

article.title: Putin wants to draft 300,000 new troops for war, Ukraine’s Zelensky says
article.summary: Ukraine thinks Russia is planning to draft an additional 300,000 troops for its war effort after Russian parliamentary elections in mid-September, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has said. Moscow’s forces are pressing ahead with an effort to capture the rest of eastern Ukraine’s industrialised Donbas region, where its troops have ground ‌forward at what Kyiv says is a great cost.
